review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Reviewed before editing these recovery and native flow tests; final independent recheck required
review.notes: Responds to independent R1 upload receipt leakage, R2 bilingual drift, and exact CI44008892966 Android phone/tablet flow24 failure after moving global appearance. No gate bypass, real-session send, installation, dependencies, or device acceptance claim. Original DFC002 already covers the separately strengthened thumbnail geometry case.

cases.description: Editing a previously uploaded image invalidates its receipt while cancel/no-change preserves the original
cases.setup: Execute the real annotation handlers for a complete uploaded attachment retained after failure, alongside a queued attachment; isolate canvas, image loading and transport boundaries only.
cases.action: Draw and save a replacement, then retry; separately cancel or export without new marks and reject export.
cases.expected: Saved replacement loses old path, progress and complete/failed phase before redraw and requires upload; unrelated files and caption retain identity. Cancel/no-change/export failure retain the valid original.

cases.description: Appearance flows reach the actual global color-scheme control using stable identity
cases.setup: Existing synthetic Android phone/tablet flows and iOS appearance/language persistence test with the separate Appearance group and Color scheme row.
cases.action: Open the exact settings-appearance control, select dark/light/system, verify actual selected row value, and exercise existing language/relaunch assertions.
cases.expected: The actionable control, not the uppercase group heading, opens the existing shared theme picker. Each Android choice changes the actual control value; iOS existing persistence assertions remain. Flow errors still fail normally.

cases.description: Rendered composer recovers from message-send or later-file upload failure before editing an uploaded image
cases.setup: Existing local synthetic HTTP fixture and isolated headless browser; stage two images through the actual file chooser and retain uploaded attachments after an intentional failure.
cases.action: Edit the previously uploaded image, save, retry with upload acknowledgment held, then release acknowledgment; also cancel a second edit.
cases.expected: Replacement thumbnail immediately loses Uploaded, shows real uploading/saving until a fresh path is acknowledged, and final send includes the edited path. Caption and unrelated attachment survive. Cancel keeps the prior receipt. Only synthetic sends occur.
